name: Kagami Tsuki
source:
Tsuki  too obviously pretends to be Hiroki's junior from his university, while actually being a temporarily incarnated figure of goddess [url=/c1296]Kagami Tsukimi[/url] to preserve her powers. 

[Translated from Getchu]
